state.name: Kushina Watcher
state.background:
Origin: Academy Student
Starting archetype: Ninjutsu Student
Raised around Academy Student, they learned the habits and pressures expected of a Ninjutsu Student. They were raised mostly by example rather than instruction, learning more from watching than from being taught outright. They have not given a fixed account of their earlier life. Their early ninjutsu student practice was uneven but persistent, emphasizing Ninjutsu. Isamu Nara, a retired local shinobi, supplied guidance, friction, and an unfinished expectation. The turning point came when a mission-era accident exposed the cost of acting without preparation. They want to turn an uncertain beginning into earned capability and decide what place they will claim in the world. They still lack the experience and resources to turn every promising instinct into a dependable result.
